name: Galleria Trader
title: Stall Keeper
examine: Fingerless gloves, mountain prices, and a scale that has never once erred in your favor.
lines: Upper market, upper prices, upper quality — two of those are promises.
Everything the mine digs and the road hauls crosses this stall eventually. Stand here long enough and you'll see the whole world by weight.
Silver rings, mountain cloth, honest scales. The galleria's reputation walks farther than its keepers do.
